decisions.reason: Its home-page prominence, clear fit with the firm’s cloud messaging strategy, and likely investment make management inclined to continue rather than admit a failed launch.
A dedicated page and a cited customer result signal visible commitment and some market validation, so management is likely to persist with it despite any mixed performance.
Although it had only limited website visibility, it still builds directly on the core messaging portfolio, which makes management more likely to keep it and explain weak results as temporary.
As a close extension of the established fax business, it supports existing customer processes and is easier to retain than to withdraw after having marketed it.
Security is central to the firm’s stated value proposition, so even with modest public emphasis management is likely to keep this offering rather than reverse course.
